note: Found by the derived calls oracle: 18 of the unexplained edges in clojure/core.clj were `lambda_83_6 -> lambda_83_6` on lines whose head is `(recur …)`. The analyzer pushed `calls: f -> f` with `isRecursion: true` on every recur. `recur` names no var and invokes nothing - it is a special form that transfers control to the enclosing fn/loop - and `lambda_83_6` is a GENERATED name for an anonymous function, so the target cannot be navigated at all. Removing the edge took the unexplained count 189 -> 104 and the analyzer's edge count 3237 -> 3144. Recursion is a real fact and stays on the symbol's metadata, which nothing reads today - a separate dead-capability finding, left visible rather than papered over. Pins: no self-edge for the recur-based function, metadata still set, and the ordinary direct self-call still published so the fix cannot be satisfied by dropping self-edges wholesale.
